extensionName.description: Extension name shown in the browser.

extensionDescription.message: Detects broken pages caused by Pi-hole and suggests which blocked domains to allow — ranked by confidence, one click to whitelist.
extensionDescription.description: One-sentence description shown in the add-on store and about:addons.

popupRefreshTitle.description: Tooltip for the refresh button in the popup.

popupReloadBarText.message: Allowlist updated. Reload page to test.
popupReloadBarText.description: Banner shown after a successful allow action.

popupReloadTab.description: Button to reload the active tab after an allow action.

popupEmptyTitle.description: Headline when there is nothing to suggest.

popupEmptyHint.message: Reload the page that looks broken, then reopen this popup.

popupManualWildcardLabel.description: Label next to the manual-add wildcard checkbox.

popupSuggestionAllow.description: Default label of the allow button on each suggestion.

popupSuggestionAllowAnyway.description: Allow-button label when the failure was not blocked by Pi-hole.

popupAllowExists.description: Allow button state when the domain was already on the allowlist.

popupStatusLoading.description: Status while the popup fetches data.

popupStatusConfigure.message: Configure your Pi-hole URL in Settings first.
popupStatusConfigure.description: Status shown when the Pi-hole URL is missing.

popupStatusInternalTab.message: Open a regular http(s) page to use this extension.
popupStatusInternalTab.description: Status shown when the active tab is about:/moz-extension:/etc.

popupStatusNoQueries.message: No DNS queries from $IP$ in the scan window. Is this machine actually using Pi-hole as its DNS resolver?
popupStatusNoQueries.description: Warning when the configured client IP returned zero queries.

popupPageHostPrefix.description: Shown next to the title to indicate the current tab's host.

popupAllowWholeSite.description: Label of the wildcard-toggle on each suggestion.

popupReasonSubdomains.description: Reason snippet when more than one subdomain is in the same group.

popupReasonRecently.description: Reason snippet showing how often the domain was queried.

popupReasonSameSite.message: Same registrable domain as the page
popupReasonSameSite.description: Reason snippet when the candidate matches the page's registrable domain.

popupReasonDirectMatch.description: Reason snippet when the browser had a failure for this hostname.

popupReasonNotBlocked.description: Category shown when the failure has no matching Pi-hole block.

popupReasonFailed.description: Reason snippet showing the browser error code.

popupMetaSummary.description: Footer meta when no other-app filtering happened.

popupMetaSummaryWithHidden.description: Footer meta when the strict-match filter hid some suggestions.

popupManualErrorInvalid.message: Enter a valid domain like example.com.
popupManualErrorInvalid.description: Error shown when manual-add input is not a valid domain.

optionsTitle.description: Top headline of the settings page.

optionsIntro.message: Connects to your Pi-hole's v6 API. Credentials are stored locally in this browser profile and never leave your machine.
optionsIntro.description: Intro paragraph on the settings page.

optionsLabelUrl.description: Label for the Pi-hole URL field.

optionsHintUrl.message: e.g. http://pi.hole or https://10.0.0.2:443. No trailing slash needed.
optionsHintUrl.description: Hint under the Pi-hole URL field.

optionsHintPassword.message: Pi-hole v6 lets you generate dedicated app passwords under Settings → Web interface / API → Application password. Use one of those here — it bypasses 2FA/TOTP and stays valid even if you rotate your main login. Leave empty if your Pi-hole has no password configured.

optionsLabelClientIp.description: Label for the client IP field.

optionsHintClientIp.message: If set, only blocked queries from this IP are considered. Leave blank to use all clients.
optionsHintClientIp.description: Hint under the client IP field.

optionsLabelScanWindow.description: Label for the scan window field.

optionsHintScanWindow.message: How far back to look for blocked queries when the popup opens.
optionsHintScanWindow.description: Hint under the scan window field.

optionsLabelLanguage.description: Label for the UI language dropdown.

optionsLanguageAuto.description: First option of the language dropdown.

optionsHintLanguage.message: Default follows your browser locale. Override if you'd rather pick the language explicitly. Changing this reloads the settings page.

optionsLabelShowBadge.message: Show failure count badge on toolbar icon
optionsLabelShowBadge.description: Checkbox label for the toolbar badge.

optionsLabelStrictMatch.message: Only suggest domains the browser actually requested in this tab

optionsHintStrictMatch.message: Recommended. Filters out unrelated DNS noise from other apps (Slack, WhatsApp, Spotify, OS telemetry, …) that share your Pi-hole client IP. Turn off to see every blocked query from your IP in the time window — useful for debugging, noisy in normal use.

optionsRecentTitle.description: Section heading for the recently-allowed list.

optionsRecentEmpty.description: Empty state for the recently-allowed list.

optionsRecentUndo.description: Undo button next to a recently-allowed entry.

optionsMutedTitle.description: Section heading for the muted-domain list.

optionsMutedEmpty.description: Empty state for the muted-domain list.

optionsMutedUnmute.description: Unmute button next to a muted entry.

optionsRecentMeta.description: Meta line under each recently-allowed entry.

optionsStatusTesting.description: Shown while the connection test runs.

optionsStatusSetUrlFirst.description: Shown when Test/Detect is clicked without a URL.

optionsStatusTestOk.message: Connected. Got $N$ recent queries in the last 60 s.

optionsStatusDetecting.description: Shown while detecting the client IP.

optionsStatusDetectSession.message: Detected client IP via session: $IP$. Click Save to keep it.
optionsStatusDetectSession.description: Shown after detection via session endpoint.

optionsStatusDetectProbe.message: Detected client IP via DNS probe: $IP$. Click Save to keep it.
optionsStatusDetectProbe.description: Shown after detection via DNS probe.

optionsStatusDetectFailed.message: Could not auto-detect. Is Pi-hole the DNS resolver for this machine? You can enter the IP manually.
optionsStatusDetectFailed.description: Shown when the DNS probe could not be located.

optionsStatusProbeNoIp.message: Probe found but client IP missing from response.
optionsStatusProbeNoIp.description: Shown when the probe entry has no client IP.

optionsStatusUndoFailed.description: Shown when removing an allow entry fails.
